description: Compare a supplied x402 quote with the latest comparable cached public unpaid quote and disclosed retained history. Scout keeps only the latest probe; the separate public index can retain seven days. $0.001 USDC on Base for a usable comparison, no trial. Missing/stale/ambiguous evidence returns unknown without charge. Never fetches or pays the target. Informational historical comparison, not payment approval or loss prevention. Price: 0.001 USDC. Minimal input example: {"url":"https://api.example.com/data","amount":"10000","payTo":"0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111","asset":"0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913","network":"eip155:8453"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"status":"unknown","baseline":null,"multiple":null,"suggested_max_amount_per_payment":null,"not_charged":true}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): Unknown evidence returns without charge; a usable comparison requires payment. No shared trial. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.
